# Junction
URL: /docs/themes/junction
Description: Rail-based technical theme with dashed structure and square junction marks
Related: /docs/themes, /docs/themes/creating-themes, /docs/customization/colors, /docs/customization/typography

Use `junction()` from the matching framework theme package and import `@farming-labs/theme/junction/css` globally. It supports Next.js, TanStack Start, Farm.js, SvelteKit, Astro, and Nuxt. Verify dashed header, sidebar, TOC, and section rails; blue active states; full-width heading separators; and top-right/bottom-left square marks on technical surfaces. If colors load without structure, repair the shared CSS import. If the factory fails to resolve, use the matching framework package subpath.
